For the Appellant/s : Mr. Ravi Ranjan, Advocate  For the Respondent/s : Mr. Parmeshwar Mehta, APP.

 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ASHUTOSH KUMAR  and  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE JITENDRA KUMAR  ORAL ORDER  (Per: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ASHUTOSH KUMAR)
3 15-05-2024 Re. I.A. No. 1 of 2024 :-

Mr. Ravi Ranjan, the learned Advocate for the appellant/ applicant presses I.A. No.
01 of 2024 seeking condonation of delay of 24 days in preferring this appeal.
2. For the reasons stated in the application, the delay of 24 days in preferring this appeal is condoned.

This appeal is against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 29.05.2023/
31.05.2023 passed in Children Case No. 03 of 2019 Patna High Court CR.

APP (DB) No.870 of 2023(3) dt.15-05-2024 arising out of Jahanabad Mahila P.S. Case No. 55 of 2018 by the learned 1st Additional Sessions Judge-cum- Spl. Judge Children's Court, Jehanabad, whereby the appellant has been convicted for the offences under Section 376(AB) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
